sources.ref: Owner direction 2026-10-10: $3.50 flat to all completers (consent.reference@v7 bonus offer)
S5 approved protocol: $4 online base, no bonus selected

notes: v5 (2026-10-10, owner direction): base_cents 300 -> 350 to match consent.reference@v7, which offers '$3.00 plus a $0.50 bonus for correctly locating your assigned crates'. The bonus is PAID TO EVERY COMPLETER regardless of accuracy (university IRB: an offered incentive paid out to everyone is low-risk non-deception; the debrief discloses this), so the ledger stays a flat 350-cent base and bonus.type stays none — the contingent frame is consent/instructions/banner copy only, never a payout rule.
v4 (2026-10-09, owner direction): base_cents 400 -> 300 to match consent.reference@v6 ($3.00 for ~12 minutes). Rules otherwise identical to v3 (activatable, technical_stop base_paid, no bonus).
Proposed for v2 profiles. Stays non-activatable until D04 confirms base pay and technical-stop/withdrawal handling. No ratings-contingent pay.

D04 revised (2026-10-07, BA-97 audit remediation) to the consent-v4 rule: completed and technical_stop sessions keep base pay (technical_stop is system-initiated, not early leave); abandoned and withdrawn sessions forfeit the base (consent: leaving early is unpaid); declined is never owed. withdrawal handling now lives in manifest outcomes.withdrawal_payment=forfeits_base.
Approved for live pilot fielding (2026-10-07): body identical to v2 (base_cents 400, activatable, technical_stop base_paid).
